messages.text: Hi my name is Paul Irvine my phone number is: 0499 295 750. I've lived in a Caravan on my friend's property for 2 years paying $270/week consistently. I also keep a tidy space. I'm in a situation where my friend asks me to work 8-9 hours a day/5 days a week on his boarding house, 2 caravans and boat fixing things up for minimal payment i.e. ($50/a day). When I tell him I can't work - he threatens eviction. This led to a decline in my mental health and I lost my job. I'm now on the Disability Pension and also eligible for rent assistance so will be able to afford this amount without a job. I hope with stable accommodation my mental health can improve and I can one day return to work.
